claims.text: Lower-extremity superficial venous thrombosis ≤ 3 cm from the saphenofemoral junction: anticoagulate as for DVT for 6 weeks or longer.
claims.quote: In patients with lower extremity superficial venous thrombosis ≤ 3 cm from the saphenofemoral junction, treatment with anticoagulation as for a deep vein thrombosis for 6 weeks or longer is recommended

claims.text: Interactions: avoid P-gp inducers (eg, rifampin), which lower dabigatran levels;
claims.quote: The concomitant use of PRADAXA with P-gp inducers (e.g., rifampin) reduces exposure to dabigatran and should generally be avoided
claims.locator: 5.5 Effect of P-gp Inducers and Inhibitors on Dabigatran Exposure

claims.text: P-gp inhibitors raise levels, especially with renal impairment,
claims.quote: P-gp inhibition and impaired renal function are the major independent factors that result in increased exposure to dabigatran
claims.locator: 5.5 Effect of P-gp Inducers and Inhibitors on Dabigatran Exposure

claims.text: so reduce to 75 mg twice daily with dronedarone or systemic ketoconazole at CrCl 30–50 mL/min.
claims.quote: Reduce the dosage of PRADAXA Capsules to 75 mg twice daily when dronedarone or systemic ketoconazole is co-administered with PRADAXA Capsules in patients with moderate renal impairment (CrCl 30-50 mL/min).
claims.locator: 2.2 Recommended PRADAXA Capsules Dosage for Adults (Dosage Adjustments with P-gp Inhibitors)

claims.text: Counseling: swallow capsules whole with a full glass of water;
claims.quote: PRADAXA Capsules should be swallowed whole. PRADAXA Capsules should be taken with a full glass of water.

claims.text: breaking, chewing or emptying them raises exposure.
claims.quote: Breaking, chewing, or emptying the contents of the capsule can result in increased exposure

claims.text: Don't stop early: premature discontinuation raises thrombotic risk.
claims.quote: Premature discontinuation of any oral anticoagulant, including PRADAXA, increases the risk of thrombotic events.
claims.locator: WARNING: (A) PREMATURE DISCONTINUATION OF PRADAXA INCREASES THE RISK OF THROMBOTIC EVENTS, and (B) SPINAL/EPIDURAL HEMATOMA

claims.text: Reversal for emergency surgery or urgent procedures:
claims.quote: Use a specific reversal agent (idarucizumab) in case of emergency surgery or urgent procedures
claims.locator: 2.8 Discontinuation for Surgery and Other Interventions

claims.quote: The recommended dose of PRAXBIND is 5 g, provided as two separate vials each containing 2.5 g/50 mL idarucizumab
